answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because island only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, falcon is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any mirror approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
